method: Actual Chrome UI interactions, downloaded export independently parsed from disk, and visual inspection of the screenshots.

checks.observed: Searching quick-release finds Field tripod by its description.
An unknown search shows a friendly empty state; Clear filters restores the collection.
Audio shows only the wireless microphone set and handheld recorder.
A quantity of 4 is rejected with the explicit 1-to-3 limit.
15 days is rejected with the explicit 1-to-14-day limit.
Three camera units for 14 days are recorded for the demo team; due date is 9 November 2026.
After borrowing all three cameras, the catalog shows 0/3 and disables its Borrow button.
Three recorder units are rejected because only two exist; no invalid loan is added.
Two valid loans restore after reload, with 15 available units and two active loans.
Five of 20 units borrowed produces 25% utilization; Camera is 3/3 and Audio is 2/6.
Returning the three cameras restores 18 available units, one active loan and 10% utilization.
The camera record remains in Returned with its hand-back date and returned label.
Downloaded kitcrew-workspace.json was parsed from disk: two records, one active, one returned, 18 available units and 10% utilization. Copy: browser-export.json.
Keep my records closes the confirmation and preserves both records.
Confirmed reset followed by reload gives all 20 available units and zero loans.
Catalog, Team loans, The big picture, Review team loans, Find some gear and home work; closing checkout adds no loan.
Rendered desktop has no horizontal overflow; all three screenshots were visually inspected.

finalWorkspace: Reset to an empty demo: 20 available units, zero loans.
